observations.why: The text carries competence as a value: verification of calibration against reference plates is mastery and quality-of-craft language, not mere assertion.
Labeling the instrument by name in a calibration record carries competence — the craft of knowing and naming one's tools — but the signal is thin and structural rather than a motivated value appeal.
Verification against established reference plates carries both competence (mastery, quality of craft) and conservation (tradition, keeping what works — the reference plates as the stable standard).
